upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Follow the visual framing guides so your custom pet generates accurately.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage drops heavily (60.9%) and support receives emails, but adoption redesigns consistently showed no/negative effect across 2 tests.

candidates.score_note: Extreme wait times on home step (201s median / 2336s mean) point to opportunity, though new flows on home previously saw -2.0%.

new_overlay_check.headline: Confirm Desktop Visibility
new_overlay_check.body: Ensure your companion is visible and positioned comfortably on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification screen following home_intro is allowed as part of onboarding flexibility under rule 4.

guard.reason: Adding a background rendering hint to the waiting screen is permitted waiting-screen information under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Extremely high wait duration on home stage indicates uncertainty; low-cost config hint can reduce abandonment during background rendering.
